name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PrivateMIFE.serial_key_floor
title: Explicit bit-parallel key expansion exhausts the write budget under a 128-bit component floor
statement: If a prefix and remaining table widths cover 128 witness bits and every table has fewer than 2^32 rows, the number 2^prefix times 128^(number of tables) is at least 2^32.
